summary.name: Finicky
summary.one_liner: A free, open source macOS app that routes each link you click to a browser chosen by rules you set.
use_cases: Send work links to Chrome and personal links to Safari
Open links in a specific Firefox or Chrome profile
Strip utm tracking parameters from URLs
Redirect x.com links to another front end
Route links differently depending on which app opened them
Test which routing rule matches a given URL
summary.what_it_does: Finicky is a macOS app that acts as the default browser and forwards each URL to a browser based on rules. Rules can match URLs by wildcard pattern, by the app that opened the link, or by window title. Users can set rules in the app's interface or write a ~/.finicky.js or ~/.finicky.ts file for full programmatic control, including match functions and URL rewrites. It can target specific Firefox or Chrome profiles, not just the browser. The app also has a way to paste a URL and see which rule matches.
notable: Config as JavaScript or TypeScript with match functions and URL rewrites
Can target specific Firefox or Chrome profiles
Routes based on which app opened the link and window title
caveats: Advanced routing requires writing a config file in JavaScript or TypeScript
